candidates: Current classic complete-hand sequence plus the existing six neural beam sequences; deduplicate identical finger sequences with classic retained on ties
objective: (-sequenceLogProbability + physicalCostWeight * classicPlannerTotalCost) / physicalContactCount; minimize separately per hand, classic wins exact objective ties
weightRationale: One neural nat trades against ten existing planner cost units. Fixed engineering choice before this evaluation; no reference-based tuning or weight sweep.
likelihood: Teacher-force each sequence through the unchanged pretrained model using its own past choices. Future context contains only original source anchors, never the proposed future digits or reference labels.
constraints: Validate identity, source anchors and complete-hand feasibility with the current planner; independently reject held-key/finger conflicts. Preserve unsupported hands and all source metadata.
evaluation: All existing 262 consumed cases, 39264 source notes, all evidence and original partitions retained. Not a new holdout or a published-paper replication.
gates: Do not reduce matches in any source-qualified passage family
Do not reduce complete-case, complete-hand or adjacent-transition agreement
Do not reduce coverage or feasible hands
No independent physical violations or changed source music/anchors
runtime: Report baseline, candidate planning and true likelihood-scoring timings separately. This is an offline research implementation, not a production latency claim.
decision: Human review is optional and is not a prerequisite. A failed automated gate retains the released planner; successful regression gates permit further automated validation but do not resolve consumed-data limitations or model deployment rights. No production replacement or publication is part of this experiment.
